title: Selling Plans Thresholds for Past-Due Restriction and Closure
content:
Seller fees on every **Selling Plans** tier are collected by deduction from the seller's Northloop Payments balance. The thresholds below set, for each plan, how long a fee balance may stay past due before the plan is restricted, and how long a plan may stay restricted with fees still past due before it is closed.

| Plan | How billed seller fees are collected | Calendar days past due before restriction | Calendar days restricted, fees still past due, before closure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | Deducted from the payments balance | 30 | 60 |
| Starter Store | Deducted from the payments balance | 30 | 60 |
| Basic Store | Deducted from the payments balance | 30 | 60 |
| Premium Store | Deducted from the payments balance | 30 | 60 |
| Anchor Store | Deducted from the payments balance | 45 | 90 |
| Enterprise Store | Deducted from the payments balance | 60 | 90 |

## Comparing the tiers

The Individual Seller Plan and the Starter, Basic and Premium Store share the shortest thresholds (30 and 60 days). The Anchor Store allows 45 days before restriction and 90 days before closure; the Enterprise Store allows 60 days before restriction and 90 days before closure.
